Name: Fish Exclusions
Author: gzhynko
Description:
A simple SMAPI mod that allows you to easily exclude certain fish or items from catchable fish types through config. Supports conditional exclusions based on season, weather, and/or location.


[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip its folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Configuration
[/size][list]
[*][code]﻿ItemsToExclude[/code] - The items to exclude.
[list]
[*][code]CommonExclusions[/code] - Season-, weather-, and location-independent exclusions. Format: [ .. <[i]comma-separated item IDs[/i]> ..  ].
[*][code]ConditionalExclusions[/code] - Season-, weather-, and location-dependent exclusions. Format: [ .. <[i]comma-separated conditional exclusion objects[/i]> .. ].
[list]
[*][code]Season[/code] - Season requirement. Format: <[i]spring/summer/fall/winter [/i]or[i] (empty[/i])>.
[*][code]Weather[/code] - Weather requirement. Format: <[i]rain/sunny [/i]or[i] (empty)[/i]>.
[*][code]Location[/code] - Location requirement. Format: <[i]location name (supports custom maps) [/i]or[i] (empty)[/i]>.
[*][code]Exclusions
[/code] - The items to exclude provided the conditions above are met. Format: [ .. <[i]comma-separated item IDs[/i]> .. ].
[/list][/list][*][code]ItemToCatchIfAllFishIsExcluded[/code] - The ID of the item to catch if all possible fish for this water body / season / weather is excluded. Format: <[i]item ID[/i]>.
[*][code]TimesToRetry[/code] - The number of times to retry the 'fish choosing' algorithm before giving up and catching the item specified above. [b]Warning:[/b] Large numbers can cause a Stack Overflow exception. Format: <[i]number[/i]>.
[/list]
﻿[size=4]Example configurations[/size]
   This configuration always excludes all junk items from possible catchables, while keeping all other options default.
[spoiler][code]﻿{
  "ItemsToExclude": {
   "CommonExclusions": [
  "167",
  "168",
  "169",
  "170",
  "171",
  "172"
],
"ConditionalExclusions": []
  },
  "ItemToCatchIfAllFishIsExcluded": "168",
  "TimesToRetry": 20
}
[/code][/spoiler]
   This configuration always excludes all junk items from possible catchables, and Sea Cucumber and Seaweed only during summer on Farm map in any weather, while keeping all other options default.
[spoiler][code]﻿{
  "ItemsToExclude": {
"CommonExclusions": [
  "167",
  "168",
  "169",
  "170",
  "171",
  "172"
],
"ConditionalExclusions": [
  {
"Season": "summer",
"Location": "Farm",
"FishToExclude": [
"154",
"152"
]
  }
]
  },
  "ItemToCatchIfAllFishIsExcluded": "168",
  "TimesToRetry": 20
}
[/code][/spoiler]
   This configuration always excludes several fish added by Stardew Valley Expanded, while keeping all other options default.
[spoiler][code]﻿{
  "ItemsToExclude": {
"CommonExclusions": [
  "Starfish",
  "Puppyfish"
],
"ConditionalExclusions": []
  },
  "ItemToCatchIfAllFishIsExcluded": "168",
  "TimesToRetry": 20
}
[/code][/spoiler]

[size=4]Console Commands
[/size][list]
[*][code]fex_toggle[/code] - Toggle all exclusions on or off.
[*][code]fex_reload[/code] - Reload the mod config. Updates excluded fish.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility
[/size][list][*]Compatible with SMAPI 3.12 and higher (the latest version is recommended).
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5 and higher.
[/list]
